decision.reason: The measured_search_demand route has no verified absolute search-demand value or query-volume source. The brand_decision_signals route has two distinct controlled intents and two eligible independent editorial signals, but the evidence does not establish a mature, established brand strongly enough to claim this route. GitHub star counts and growth are awareness/adoption clues, not proof of established buyer demand or measured search volume.
decision.nextAction: Obtain one independent, reproducible established-brand/adoption signal that is not merely a restatement of repository star counts, or obtain a positive absolute search-demand measurement from a documented query-data source. Re-evaluate only this missing qualification; reuse the existing entity, page, localization and media PASS.

excludedAsSearchDemand.reason: Accepted only as one external trend candidate signal. The reported +12% and multiplier are relative trend measures, not an absolute search-volume value; the source does not provide a reproducible positive query-volume figure in this review.

brandDecisionAssessment.rationale: The project appears to have substantial awareness, but the available evidence describes a fast-growing project launched in 2026 and largely reports repository popularity. The reviewed sources do not independently establish sustained buyer adoption, and the current policy supplies no numeric star-count threshold that would justify treating repository popularity alone as established-brand proof.

intentEvidence.note: Both are original buyer-oriented evaluations on different non-official domains.
Both discuss alternatives or comparison choices; this confirms decision intent, not established-brand status.

independentSignals.scope: Original hands-on evaluation reports a fresh sandbox install, memory footprint, production-build failure and test timeout, and identifies appropriate buyer profiles and alternatives. These are that publisher's observed results, not an AI Best Tool test.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: Distinct non-official domain and hands-on method. It provides installation/build/resource observations rather than merely repeating vendor feature claims.

independentSignals.scope: Original buyer-oriented source and documentation review dated 2026-09-02. It states that it did not perform a local runtime test, identifies material unknowns, and recommends a controlled pilot for specified technical buyers.
independentSignals.nonDuplication: Different non-official registrable domain and a source/documentation-review method, not the sandbox installation evaluation published by MrKeyoor.

excludedSources.reason: Official project repository. Valid for product identity and technical claims, but excluded from the required non-official independent-signal count. Repository stars are not measured search demand.
Official product website. Valid for identity and product claims, but excluded from independent market signals.

Original comparison coverage confirms review/vs intent, but this page prominently markets the author's consulting services and relies heavily on repository/maintainer claims. Excluded from the two-signal minimum to avoid overstating independent adoption evidence.
The post discloses that the author is the maintainer, so it is self-promotion rather than an independent signal.
Directory/listing-style tool page; not accepted as independent editorial buyer coverage or a specific adoption-market signal.

measuredSearchDemand.note: No reproducible absolute search-volume value, dated query report, or positive measured query demand was present in the reviewed evidence. This is unavailable evidence, not a finding of zero demand.
